title: Size each point by a third measure only when its size answers the question.
rule: Draw the scatter plot with each circle’s area set by a third measure, never its radius (Rule 14.4), the largest drawn first and each with a 1 px outline so overlaps read. Give a key of two circle sizes over the plot, name the circle the title names in the subject ink, and keep the Association label and its note.
use_when: The reader asks whether two measures move together and also how many people each place holds.

use_instead.when: The circle sizes add nothing the question asks
Size alone matters, on a map

text: Size lets a large place weigh as much on the page as it does in the country, so a small state at an extreme does not read as the whole story. Area, not radius, keeps a circle twice as large in value from looking four times as large.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form bubble-scatter: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s55; encode size for the area; labels.size_key gives the key’s sizes and labels.size_key_title its words.
